set.n: Missing $1,025 from an 1898 roadside shooting, road to Holy Hill
set.pl: Woods about ½ mi up the old Hartford-Holy Hill road from the farmhouse in sec. 35 T10N R18E (c.1915 Hixson plat), about halfway out from Hartford
pinev: Road-segment level: the farmhouse the victim crawled to is on the c.1915 Hixson plat in sec. 35 T10N R18E beside the old Hartford-Holy Hill road; the shooting was in woods about ½ mi back up the road (about 900 m).
set.st: May 31, 1898: a Milwaukee grocer was lured toward Holy Hill, shot by his buggy about halfway out from Hartford and dragged into the woods. He said he carried $1,025 in a canvas bag; the bag and the revolver were never found (only $5.75 was on him), though the paper doubted he had more than $100-300. The shooter got one year for assault. Folk belief: the money and gun were hidden in the woods. Private farmland: permission. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: Weak: the bag may never have held much. Woods along the old Holy Hill road near sec. 35. Access: private farmland, ask permission.
src: Hartford dispatch June 1898 (TN TreasureNet Treasure Legends - Wisconsin thread 563350)
